author: Antigravity Data Science & Remote Sensing Pipeline

pre_overlap_historical.purpose: Historical MODIS-only baseline; sensor transition test at Jan 2012 seam

validation.purpose: Hyperparameter selection, dispersion calibration, zero-frequency hurdle check

test.purpose: Strictly held-out out-of-sample final evaluation and generalisation test

Block_1_NorthEast.description: Northern coastal and plain districts (Chennai, Thiruvallur, Kancheepuram, Chengalpattu, Viluppuram)

Block_2_NorthWest.description: Northwestern plateau and inland dry belt (Dharmapuri, Krishnagiri, Salem, Vellore, Tirupathur)

Block_3_CentralEast_Delta.description: Cauvery agricultural delta and central plain (Thanjavur, Tiruvarur, Nagapattinam, Mayiladuthurai, Cuddalore)

Block_4_CentralWest.description: Western Ghats montane forests and foothills (The Nilgiris, Coimbatore, Erode, Tiruppur, Dindigul)

Block_5_South.description: Southern semi-arid plains and littoral (Madurai, Sivaganga, Virudhunagar, Ramanathapuram, Thoothukkudi, Tirunelveli, Tenkasi, Kanniyakumari)

step_B.name: Negative Binomial GLM
step_B.model_type: Log-link Negative Binomial GLM with exposure offset and land-cover interactions

step_C.name: Hurdle Negative Binomial
step_C.model_type: Two-part Hurdle (Logit zero gate + Truncated Negative Binomial)

model_B_cell.name: Cell-Week Total FRP Model
model_B_cell.model_type: Two-part Log-Linear / Gamma model conditional on positive fire count

promotion_rules.simplicity_rule: Prefer simpler interpretable model (GLM) unless a complex model exceeds improvement threshold on held-out data without degrading sensor transition

downscaling_rules.fallback: Uniform 1/7 allocation only when zero overpass evidence exists across entire week
downscaling_rules.constraint: Daily values must reconcile exactly to weekly total (sum_d V_{c,d} == V_{c,w})
